front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Agility for WIMSE Workload Identity
front.workgroup: Workload Identity in Multi System Environments

abstract.t: This document extends WIMSE Workload Credentials and Workload Authentication Using Mutual TLS with post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) algorithm identifiers, hybrid certificate chains, and a pqc_epoch_id claim. The extensions enable service-mesh deployments to enforce PQC rotation epochs across workload-to-workload authentication.

The extensions are designed for service meshes and multi-tenant workload identity authorities. Concrete tenant isolation parameters are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: Workload identity in service meshes uses short-lived credentials and frequent rotation. Migrating those credentials to PQC requires explicit algorithm and epoch metadata so that authentication policy can be enforced uniformly across the mesh.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: Credential Extensions
section.t: WIMSE workload credentials compliant with this document MUST include a pqc_algorithm claim and a pqc_epoch_id claim. When the credential carries a hybrid chain, the hybrid_pair claim MUST also be present.

section.name: Authentication Processing
section.t: Authenticators MUST verify pqc_epoch_id against the configured minimum epoch and MUST reject credentials that carry classical-only algorithms in PQC-required postures.

section.name: Tenant Considerations
section.t: Workload identity authorities operating in multi-tenant environments MUST scope pqc_epoch_id values per tenant. Concrete tenant carve-out implementation parameters are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The extensions do not transport private-key material. Authorities SHOULD rotate workload credentials at intervals consistent with their PQC rotation epoch.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to register pqc_algorithm, pqc_epoch_id, and hybrid_pair claim names in the WIMSE claim registry.
